contradictions.fact: One-way / round-trip distance to Dutch Miller Gap and the climb

claims.says: Hike the Middle Fork Snoqualmie / Williams Creek corridor roughly 15 miles to Dutch Miller Gap (~4.8 hrs), then continue to a camp below the SW Face. Total round-trip trail distance for the outing is about 22 miles.
11 (one-way, to the summit)

contradictions.why: If Dutch Miller Gap alone is 15 miles one-way (before continuing further to camp and the climb), the round trip cannot be only 'about 22 miles' — that would require roughly 11 miles one-way, which is what waypoints[1].distMi (11) implies. The approach field's own two numbers do not reconcile with each other or with the waypoint distance.
